description: Ex-Israeli-operated 707 retired with its engines removed near Kiryat Shmona; bought in 1999 by the brothers Ata and Khamis al-Sairafi and trucked with its wings removed to Wadi al-Badhan; conversion stalled for roughly twenty years and it opened as a restaurant and coffee shop on 21 July 2021 with visitors paying an entry fee to see the cabin and cockpit. Sourced to wire coverage; Arabic Wikipedia has no article on it. NOTE the brief for this pass described two 707s under different owners at Jabal Al-Nar; every source found describes ONE aircraft at Wadi al-Badhan. Status since 2023 is unconfirmed
